reviews.text: We did private lessons with Natalie, and it was wonderful! Our dog is 7 months old, leash reactive, and had a hard time adjusting to city life. Natalie gave us useful and approachable tools to help with this. She always came prepared with exercises and was very knowledgeable on pet behavior, answering all of our questions! We are thankful we did the private lessons—they helped get our pup off on the right foot and gave us the tools and knowledge to continue training her moving forward.

Maureen was excellent. Our pittie/staffie pup went from needing multiple fences and sheets between him and strangers (sessions 1-4) to having Maureen doing home visits and, during our last session, allowing me and my partner to leave him and Maureen alone in the house together!
The progress has been outstanding, and we’ll continue to use Tucker Pups—Maureen specifically—for future training needs.

We’ve had a really great experience working with Phaedra through Tucker Pup’s Drop-Off Training program. We originally signed Cliff up for one round and have already started a second because of how much progress we’ve seen.

Cliff came into the program as a typical high-energy puppy with a short attention span, especially in distracting environments. Since working with Phaedra, we’ve seen noticeable improvements in his focus, leash behavior, and overall ability to settle and make better decisions both at home and outside.

What we’ve appreciated most is how thoughtful and practical her approach is. She does a great job balancing structured training with real-world application, and the weekly progress sessions have been extremely helpful for us as owners to understand how to reinforce everything at home.

She’s also been very honest and communicative about Cliff’s progress, which we’ve really valued. It’s clear she cares about the dogs she’s working with and wants to set them up for long-term success, not just short-term results.

Overall, we’ve been very happy with the program and working with Phaedra, it’s been a great investment for Cliff and for us.

We enrolled our 5 month old husky/chow/German shepherd puppy in the drop-off training program and we could not be happier! Our trainer, Olivia, is fantastic! Our puppy loves his sessions with Olivia and loves the playgroups he gets to be in when he's not in 1-on-1 training. We can't recommend Tucker Pups enough!

Great experience across the board with grooming, training, and boarding!
Update: Phaedra has been amazing with drop off training. Our dog Koda absolutely loves her and she does an excellent job of listening to our needs as pawrents and pivoting as needed, too. She really goes above and beyond, is kind and soft, but still stern enough to train Koda effectively (and get us humans on the right page too when we need to adjust our own training behavior). Fantastic experience.

Helena was absolutely fantastic. We would work with her over and over again. We wish there was space in daycare for Auggie to keep coming to Tuckers. It would be amazing if you offered daycare with occasional training days built in to reup on skills with your favorite trainer. We would come back to Helena over and over again!
Tiffany, Patrick and Auggie

Hands down the best training in the city. We worked with Helena Love at Tucker Pups (drop-off training) and our 6 month old golden retriever has made remarkable progress we couldn't have done on our own. Helena is truly a dog whisperer and was extremely informative with us every step of the way. Could not recommend Helena and the Tucker Pups Resort any more!!!

Jamie was an absolute godsend for our pup Polly. Polly was an incredibly nervous dog and over the months working with Jamie she truly came out of her shell and is able to show her funny personality. Jamie was the best to work with since she really was able to break down training and relaxation protocols for Polly and for us to make sure that we never overwhelmed her. I would recommend working with Jamie any day! Polly is truly a different dog and I don't think that would have happened without Jamie's support.

I was traveling out of the country and felt very confident in the care that my dog was getting while I was away. They were consistent with photo updates, very accommodating when our travel plans abruptly changed, and he came back very happy! The staff is all very friendly and you can tell they genuinely love our animals. We’re very satisfied with his stay and will be back!

We love Tucker Pups! We started out with the training and daycare program; now we go for our grooming and boarding needs too. The staff is so friendly and helpful. Their love & care  is palpable and we always know our girl is in goods hands when she is there. Thank you Tucker Pups <3

Our dog gets very excited when he knows we are walking in! They send photos throughout his boarding which makes me know he is having a great time. They manage his food and medicine great and we have no worries leaving him!

I have no words that would do justice to Jessie and her training of my puppy. ChatGPT couldn’t even do justice as she is absolutely wonderful, professional, and fabulous at her job. My pup Okoye adores her and is now a better pup because of her.  I looked out when Kim picked her for my Pups training.

Thank you for having Jessie on your staff.

Jamie was a great trainer and my girl really loved her. She was helpful and throughout the class made sure each dog had individual attention. She addressed any concerns and offered tips readily and was extremely knowledgeable. I would love to have her as a trainer in any future classes at Tucker Pups. Throughout the class we learned the basics sit, stay, down, recall, walking on a leash, leave it, touch, paying attention to owner instead of distractions, and a few other things. I enjoyed how the dogs got to play and interact but also had personalized attention.

Burt loved his time at Tucker Pups! We just completed Adult Manners with Maureen. She is attentive and a dog whisperer. She helps trouble shoot what may be going on with certain tricks and uses the positive reinforcement method. Burt has learned so much since being in training and we can’t wait for his next round!

We have had the privilege of working with two great trainers at Tucker Pups. Courtney helped us when we first brought our rescue home and got her acclimated to the new home and obedience practices. Over time we used Jamie for more advanced behavioral training. I want to recognize both for their patience, care for our dog, and knowledge. We appreciate that Tucker pups has multiple trainers with spikes in different areas, but high quality and consistent techniques.

Jamie did an amazing job with our weekly group Adult Manners class! We brought our 9 month old Golden Retriever puppy alongside other adult dogs and she was great at managing the room and helping us with our commands. We originally came in for help with leash training and learned some great ways to help manage leash pulling outside of class on our daily downtown Chicago walks. I would definitely recommend Jamie for dog training and will be coming back to Tucker Pup's!

MANNER CLASS: we attended Adult Manner class, and although we were initially unsure about its effectiveness, it turned out to be absolutely perfect. We learned so much, especially about how to reinforce correctly. Natalie was amazing, and we loved her so much that we’ve already booked private lessons with her.
Through this experience, we also got to know Tucker Pup’s vision, culture, and environment which are exactly what we’ve been looking for for our fur baby, who is now happily enrolled in both daycare and boarding.
BOARDING: I couldn’t be happier with Ivy’s boarding experience! The team was incredibly attentive to her and all of her needs, and they made sure to keep me updated every step of the way. Their constant care and communication gave me so much peace of mind. And the photos: they were truly the cherry on top! Highly recommend!
DAYCARE: Ivy is at her happiest the moment she reaches the entrance. Her tail starts wagging, her whole body shakes, and you can just tell how much she loves being there (P.S.: after daycare, she just sleeps like a baby). Tucker’s Pup truly treats her like family: constant updates, incredible care, and so much love. We absolutely adore them.

Jas did such a great job grooming our 1 year old pup Cosmo ! You can tell from the results how she was very thorough with the cut and was excellent at the finer details around the eyes, ears and face in general. Those details are difficult for us to express in words but for example: Cosmo can see well now with no hair in his way but he still has eyebrows and even eyelashes. He looks perfect, smells so good and is even softer to touch. Thank you so much Jas and Tucker Pup !!

We love the puppy socials here - our friends recommended them and I couldn't be more grateful. Momo started going when he was 13 weeks and there was really no other place for him to run around and meet other dogs. He really loves them. And it's been so helpful for us to see how he interacts with other dogs, what to look out for, what certain behaviors signal - they're just as much a learning experience for us as they are fun. The trainers are amazing. Helena is such a calm, kind and confident presence in the room.

Phaedra is a great drop off trainer for our pup. He is an anxious guy, and she was very patient with him (and us) on making great steps to improve is confidence and our ability to understand and work with him at home. The tools were shown clearly and the online resources gave us the backup we needed to revisit those teaching skills. Our pup also enjoyed his day care time playing with all the other dogs. He was super excited when we would get ready to go to Tucker Pups for the day!

Our dog, Westley (@mrwestleys), is obsessed with Tucker’s. We’ve tried other daycare/boarding places in the city since we moved from the West Loop, but we always find ourselves returning to Tucker’s because we love them that much! We adore the photos we get of our Westley having the best time (see pics attached!) with all his other buddies under the care of the Tucker Pup’s team. We know he’ll always be well taken care of and as dog parents that’s all we can hope for when we’re out of town! We highly recommend Tucker’s for your daycare/boarding needs!!

Phaedra and MJ were great working with me and my 7-month-old dog. I wasn't sure what to expect as a first-time full dog owner with full responsibility over this canine life. The initial consultation was great, I felt like they cared about what I wanted for the end result which was a "good city dog" so not picking things up off the sidewalk, not jumping at strangers, and being able to relax in a public place. I appreciated the updates after each dropoff day and the weekly hour session to teach me what is being taught and to allow me to ask questions. I felt like I wasn't alone in raising this puppy in a big city and I will definitely refer back to the videos in the coming weeks as we learn new things. The extra bonus is the evenings after daycare when Lainey would rest peacefully after such a physically and mentally stimulating day. 10/10 for Phaedra, and MJ and the rest of the Tucker Pups staff.

Tucker Pup's is excellent all around! As first time puppy owners, we booked private training lessons with Jamie. She is awesome! The lessons were instrumental in helping us learn how to support and guide our puppy as he adapted to our home. Three months later, we are all doing great! We also brought our puppy to several of the whippersnappers puppy socials and he absolutely loved them. I truly can't say enough good things about Tucker Pup's! I highly recommend!

I have used just about every service Tucker Pup's has to offer and I am so appreciative for all they do. I have enrolled my dog in the adult manners course, stay & train, and several private courses. ALL of the trainers are the most wonderful people - so kind & gentle with the dogs, wonderful at answering my questions, committed to the positive reinforcement methods, & they go above and beyond in all aspects (shoutout to Helena, Phaedra, & Maureen).
I have boarded my dog on several different occasions and I take comfort in the detailed, level of care the staff provides. They keep a close eye on each dog in attendance to ensure their safety and fun. My dog enjoys playing with the other high energy pups, but knows she can get some love from the handlers in the room before settling in for a nap on the play stairs. At pickup the daycare/boarding staff provides me with a brief, but thorough report of my dog's day (who she played with, how she ate, how grooming went etc.).
I cannot recommend Tucker Pup's enough to anyone with a dog in need of training or boarding. Their attention to detail and care to each dog is unparalleled!

My 5 month old just completed his puppy manners course and we had a great time. Jamie was a wonderful trainer with great energy! Whittaker learned a lot in the course and was able to build on his foundation within a more lively environment. We are looking forward to intermediate training soon!

We use Tucker pup for our dog every 5 weeks.
Price is reasonable and cut is amazing.
I saw other dog/poodle leaving when we came in. This poodle cut was piece of art.

Our golden retriever puppy (Goose) absolutely LOVED the six week puppy training course. All the other dogs in the class (and their owners) were great. Jamie was amazing with the dogs and us - she really taught us how to effectively train our puppy. They are genuine, kind dog lovers at Tucker Pups. We plan to trust them with any training or boarding needs in the future. The knowledge we gained and experience for our pup was priceless. He had the best time seeing his friends every Tuesday night!

Tucker Pups is hands-down the best. We had tried other daycares in the past, but our dog was never a fan and always seemed hesitant. Since coming here, the change has been night and day. She now literally sprints through the front door!

Our trainer, Jamie, was also phenomenal. Through the behavior modification program, she gave our timid puppy, Noodle, the tools to be confident and helped us learn to read her cues to build a much stronger bond. It’s such a relief to find a team that truly understands dog behavior and cares for our pup as much as we do!

Can’t recommend Tucker Pups enough! Our dog had a pretty rough upbringing and is really scared and nervous. After doing some training with Tucker pups, we took our dog for boarding while we were out of town. (Before boarding, Tucker Pups does a free trial day to see how the dog does, which is great. Our dog was nervous on the trial day, but did well enough she could board.) We just picked her up from being out of town, and we are SO happy! We got daily pictures from Tucker Pups and all kinds of updates. Our scared little dog was so at ease that she didn’t need any of the extra anxiety medication we packed for her :)

Tucker Pups also has a ton of add-ons like daily brushing (which we did and was totally worth it), peanut butter kongs at night, and all kinds of other things! You can tell the dogs are treated with care and are appropriately stimulated. No sad, bored dogs waiting in cages all day!

If you need a place to board your dog, Tucker Pups is it!!

I’ve taken my wheaten terrier to Tucker Pups since he was a puppy (5 years!). I have tried a couple other places and always come back. The quality of cuts is consistent across multiple groomers. Our favorite groomer has been Dionne. She does a great job of leaning into to the breed standard without going full beard and long fall. It also makes me happy that my dog is thrilled to get dropped off every time. He must really enjoy his visits.

I had high hopes for Tucker Pups Resort, but unfortunately my experience was extremely disappointing. I enrolled my German Shepherd in their training and daycare program expecting improvement in behavior, especially around reactivity. Instead, I feel like my dog actually became more reactive during our time there.

The training approach seems to rely strictly on positive reinforcement, which in theory sounds great, but in our case it didn’t address my dog’s behavioral issues at all. I wasn’t given a balanced or customized plan, and it felt very one-size-fits-all. For a high-energy, working breed like a German Shepherd, that just didn’t cut it.

What’s most frustrating is that I invested a significant amount of time and money, only to end up with a dog that has worse habits than before. I don’t feel like the results matched what was promised, and I wish there had been more honesty about what their methods can and can’t achieve.

What really frustrated me was how things were handled when I brought this up. I asked about a prorated refund since the program clearly wasn’t working for my dog, and it felt like my concerns were dismissed. There was no real effort to make things right or take accountability.

Overall, I left feeling misled and disappointed. I would not recommend this facility to owners dealing with reactivity or more serious behavioral concerns.

Tucker Pup grooming is the best in the West Loop! Always attention to the smallest detail, and they make sure dogs are up on their vaccinations before providing services, keeping our dogs healthy and safe! Staff seems to enjoy their work—always upbeat and enthusiastic! Very courteous and friendly environment. So refreshing!

Jack has been going to daycare here since the start of the year and absolutely loves it. We have used the day care, grooming, boarding, and training services. We recently completed at home/private dog training with Jamie Walker. She was fantastic and extremely knowledgeable. Jack was struggling with anxiety while he was settling in with us after we adopted him, and we were feeling extremely overwhelmed with his high energy personality. Jamie helped us more than we could’ve imagine and we feel like such confident dog owners. I can’t recommend her enough!

We first met Phaedra at a puppy play session, and I immediately noticed how attentive and caring she was with all the dogs. When I found out she’d be Yiyi’s trainer for drop-off training, I had a good feeling about it - and I was absolutely right!

Phaedra always prioritized Yiyi’s feelings and wellbeing throughout the entire process. Yiyi has some very typical shiba quirks and might not be the most obedient pup, but Phaedra was so understanding and patient with her. She also explained to me the “why” behind Yiyi’s behaviors and how to work with her personality rather than against it. Her insights really helped me understand Yiyi better and figure out how to connect with Yiyi in a way that actually works for us.

Beyond just basic training techniques, Phaedra gave us so many helpful tips that made a real difference. But what really stood out was how she taught us to maintain a healthy mindset during training - for both me AND Yiyi - so we wouldn’t get too frustrated. I’d honestly never thought about that before, but it was such a game-changer in helping us stay positive and patient with each other.

Phaedra was also incredibly responsive and thorough in her communication, which meant so much to me. She was also really flexible with scheduling, which I really appreciated.

Throughout the whole process, I could see that Phaedra’s care for Yiyi was genuine and her passion for training was real. She never did the bare minimum - she always gave us more than we expected. Through working with Phaedra, Yiyi grew into a better-behaved pup, and I grew into a better dog mom who truly understands her dog. Thanks to Phaedra, Yiyi and I have a stronger bond and a happier life together. I can’t thank her enough.

In just one month, Yiyi (a very strong-willed shiba 😂) has made AMAZING progress. I’m confident that other dogs would see the same or even better results with Phaedra’s help. Phaedra is truly an EXCEPTIONAL trainer, and we’re so grateful Tucker Pup’s brought us together!

We've had nothing but amazing experiences at Tucker Pup's. From puppy socials with Helena, manners courses with Jessie and Maureen, and individual training sessions with Maureen, everyone we have worked with has been extremely knowledgeable, kind, and eager to help us overcome any obstacles and issues. The private training sessions with Maureen have been particularly helpful in addressing our pup's anxieties. We cannot recommend Tucker Pup's (and especially Maureen) highly enough!

I've been taking my small dogs to Tucker Pups for grooming every 5 weeks for a couple of years now and it's always a great experience.  The staff are friendly and good at their jobs plus my pups look and smell great when I pick them up!  Highly recommend.

Cooper didn't want to leave! Which suits us because we know he was treated well and had fun. We particularly appreciate Tucker Pup's for their ability to accommodate an unevenly socialized Australian Sheepard! They have excellent employees because he always comes home minding his p's and q's LOL! We also appreciate how well they communicate with us about anything we can improve at home, or understanding him better. Tucker Pup's is our go-to for boarding, for us it's worth every penny! Thank you Tucker Pup's!

Our pup, Vinnie, recently graduated from Puppy Manners taught by Jamie. To say she is an excellent trainer is an understatement. She is wise, kind, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable. All of her guidance was and continues to be valuable as we navigate the ways of puppy parenthood. My fiancé and I not only loved her treatment of our pup but also very much enjoyed engaging with her. We’d found ourselves saying “we can’t wait to show Jamie what he’s learned since last week!” If you’re a new puppy parent looking to shape up behaviors and manners, you’d be a fool not to work with Jamie at Tucker Pup’s!

I enrolled my 6-7 month old puppy in Tucker’s six-week training program to address my puppy’s reactivity. Unfortunately, after 5 sessions we realized the facility was not a good fit for my dog or my training goals.

My biggest concern was the lack of individualized training. The program is very focused on a single positive-reinforcement approach, and when I expressed that the methods were not working and my dog’s reactivity was actually worsening, the only alternatives offered were anxiety medication, avoiding other dogs entirely, or physically removing him from situations.

I also felt that the trainer was not particularly familiar with my dog. I frequently had to remind her about my dog’s history and behaviors, and at times it felt as though he was being confused with other dogs she was training.

While I appreciate that Tucker’s followed up after my feedback and offered a complimentary session with another trainer, I had already concluded that the training philosophy itself was not the right fit for my dog. I respect that positive reinforcement works well for many dogs, but I was looking for a more individualized approach and greater flexibility in training methods.

Overall, the program relies too heavily on a one-size-fits-all approach rather than tailoring training to the specific needs of each dog.

We had an amazing experience with Tucker Pup’s! Leaving our puppy somewhere new can be stressful, but the team made it completely stress-free from start to finish. The staff is so caring and attentive, and we had total peace of mind knowing our puppy was in the best hands. We’re so grateful to have found a place we fully trust!

We received personal training from Maureen for our recently adopted dog and he is a different guy now! She taught us so many skills for how to handle his energy on walks and how to train him in our home. If we ever have any issues again, we will be coming back.

Maureen helped my partner and I work with our rescue dog Nova who was extremely leash reactive towards other dogs on our walks. We saw improvements in Nova that we never thought were possible and Maureen gave us so many tools to help continue working on Nova’s struggles. We could tell Maureen has a personal investment in her clients and a true passion in helping dogs overcome their obstacles. We are so grateful to her for all the progress she helped Nova make, especially after our bad experience with another trainer from a different company. If you’re looking for a positive reinforcement trainer who knows what they’re doing and has a mission to help you and your dog succeed, we absolutely recommend Maureen and Tucker’s Pups!

This was our first time leaving our dog, Millie, at Tucker Pups, and we had an incredible experience from start to finish! Millie seemed genuinely happy and well-cared for during her stay, which gave us so much peace of mind. Every staff member we interacted with was kind, polite, and clearly passionate about the dogs they care for.

What really stood out to me was the transparency—when I asked for a tour, the team was more than happy to show me around. Unlike other places in the city that won’t let you see where your dog will be spending their time (which I always find a bit concerning), Tucker Pups was proud to showcase their clean, well-maintained spaces—and they should be!

Millie isn’t a fan of grooming, but the team handled her gently and gave her a nice bath without pushing her past her limits, which I really appreciated. It’s rare to find a place that truly understands and respects each dog’s individual needs.

A huge thank you to everyone at Tucker Pups for making Millie’s stay such a positive one. We’ll definitely be coming back! 🐾

my dog flyer had a great time. he’s generally pretty anxious and antisocial, but i was happy to hear that he played a little and came up to the staff for cuddles and attention. that tells me he felt safe and loved even in an unfamiliar and overwhelming space. i was so grateful for such a detailed report when i picked him up and for 3 pictures in a 4 day stay! he is passed out now and i’m sure having sweet dreams of his time with his friends :) thank you

We’ve been going to Tucker Pup’s since Arya was just 12 weeks old for training, and  we trust them with her grooming too. Raven, her favorite groomer, is incredible—every summer when we’re back in Chicago, we look forward to Arya’s best groom! The team is caring, professional, and truly passionate about dogs. Can’t recommend them enough!

If you have a puppy you must take puppy manners! Jamie is the absolute best, the progression week over week with our puppy was incredible. Theodore became more confident each week and developed into his personality! We will
Definitely be looking forward to more training and working with Jamie in the future. She is dedicated to helping each puppy parent, she is patient and helps teach everyone in the class
As always our pup Sir Winston looks gorgeous after his grooming session. Andrea did a wonderful job with Winston’s grooming, he always feels so silky and soft.

Leia loved Natalie! It was very helpful participating in the puppy starter program as a first-time dog owner. Natalie came to our apartment and gave us advice on how to help Leia become independent, gave ideas for enrichment activities, and guided us on how to expose Leia to the outside world.

My dog received in home training with Tucker Pup’s. My trainer, Courtney, was wonderful! My dog is a young toy poodle that has a lot of energy, and her behavior has greatly improved from the training. She now responds to all of the training techniques and tips that Courtney showed me and my dog  also enjoyed the training. She was attentive and always happy to see Courtney. Courtney was also very kind and very professional.  Was very good experience and I greatly appreciate her help.

No idea how I haven't left this review here yet, though better late than never! I found Tucker Pup's initially for their grooming services around fall of 2023 as they are very close to me. A year later, my pup, Kirby, is a regular here!

After having such great grooming experiences, I added myself to their daycare waitlist though I was worried I'd never get a call. Not even a month after I submitted the daycare form, I got a call from a staff member to set up a trial day. Kirby had never been to daycare before and now Kirby loves it! Their booking system on their website is so easy to use and so detailed.

I've also boarded Kirby here multiple times now and the experience is phenomenal. The first time I boarded Kirby here was the first time I had boarded him ever and I was super nervous, even with the daycare rapport. The team is so thorough when taking information in for your pets and they notice all the things about your pet. Kirby had some dry eyes from scratching too much once and they sent me a note as well saying that they notice. The team truly does care for the pups like their own.

One time I even request a grooming for Kirby and they scheduled it on a day he was going to be there for daycare and knew to put him back into play group after his spa time. I didn't even have to say anything! If they're ever unsure though, they always ask to clarify! Everything they do here makes sense!

I tell every dog owner, friend, family member, about you guys and can't say enough amazing things. I'd have a hard time finding a spot to trust with Kirby as much as I do Tucker Pup's.

Thank you always!

We absolutely love our groomer Jeff! Jeff is your go to guy particularly if you have small dogs or any dog requiring a speciality cut. I’ve had Pomeranians for decades and have lived all over the country. Jeff understands how to protect their coat and hand cuts with precision for an even blend. Luna absolutely adores him and he always shows his love for her right back. They post photos after every groom (actual photos they’ve posted to my portal) and she always looks like she’s having the time of her life. We’ve been going to Jeff since we moved to Chicago four years ago and even with our moves around the city, refuse to go elsewhere. Thank you Jeff for being so wonderful!

Jamie was awesome! She trained us as much as she trained the dogs. Our little one, Popeye, definitely won the “Most Improved” award. He was super shy in the beginning, but he really blossomed and gained a lot of confidence under Jamie’s instruction.
Our long hair German Shepard looks so neat and tidy,  he’s ready for summer with Tucker Pups amazing grooming session!  Thank you!

We enrolled in puppy manners training and just graduated. Maureen was awesome, clearly an expert in her field. The facility was very nice, all the staff are nice and we met other pup parents to keep in contact with.

We cannot thank Maureen enough for the support she provided us in training our two miniature schnauzer rescues, Minnie (2) and Pepper (8). Minnie was a new addition to our family, and I initially reached out to Tucker Pups because of her …

Great service especially grooming, my dog got canine cough after grooming at PetSmart, switched here referred by a friend, they really took care of my boy. Very strict screening process to ensure the safety of your pups. Just great, great price as well

Jamie was great at handling the dogs and their different personalities. My puppy LOVED the class and I feel he truly learned a lot. The pace was great at keeping him learning, but also manageable and he was able to grasp all of the skills. We’ll be back for more!

UPDATE TO ADDRESS OWNERS RESPONSE: We never requested a sanitary trim. If a sanitary trim is a standard part of the grooming process, our dog has never had one that resulted in 1mm of hair remaining on his stomach. In fact, when we’ve …

Upon an Instagram search, we realized so many of our friends have been here and all highly recommended Tucker Pups. We've taken five month old Oscar to two confidence builder classes so far and plan to take him to classes weekly until he's …
